_meta.note: 15-champion smoke fixture for the four-signal immunity model. Sourced verbatim from the design handover mockup (GuiaMTC June 2026 snapshot). Ships in production so the /immunities view has real data to render; will be replaced/superseded by the full GuiaMTC transcription (task #80). DO NOT delete after the transcription lands — the engine tests use this as a stable regression fixture, especially Onslaught's 150% resist marks.
